name: Tideway
summary: A freelancer's personal and studio money app with a living money river across three accounts
about: A seven-page money app for one freelancer with an everyday, a business and a joint account, in sand and saffron or a teal night theme. Its money river shows each month as flowing streams from clients and a partner through the three accounts into rent, food, studio costs and savings, and you can hover, follow or step through the months. Accounts, transactions, studio invoices, a fair-share joint page with settle-up, limits and goals all work, with sample data in rupees.
how: Open a page from the sidebar: River, Accounts, Transactions, Studio, Joint, Plan or Settings
Hover a stream in the river for its amount, click a block to follow only its flows, and step through months
Use the account switch at the top to show All, Everyday, Business or Joint
Move money between accounts or mark an invoice paid; the river and balances update
On Joint, drag your fair share and press Settle up when one of you owes the other
Edit limits and goals in Plan, press Ctrl+K to jump, and reset demo data in Settings
